proves.claim: soloLowStakesFacts returns no facts unless enabled is exactly true.

cli.io-commands-verify.solo-facts-off-by.why: Without it a verify call could carry solo low-stakes facts while the setting is off.

proves.claim: When enabled, soloLowStakesFacts returns one { id, stakes } per frozen row, a row without stakes read as team.

cli.io-commands-verify.solo-facts-from-f.why: Without it the rows would not match the item frozen record and the self-accept rule would refuse.

proves.claim: soloLowStakesFacts returns nothing for an empty, unparseable or row-less frozen record.

cli.io-commands-verify.solo-facts-never-.why: Without it a verify call could invent a row for an item that froze none.

proves.claim: soloLowStakesFacts marks a row personApproved only when the spec approval state is readable and does not list the row as agent-approved.

cli.io-commands-verify.solo-person-appro.why: Without it an agent that lowered a row's stakes would still read as person-approved and could self-accept.

proves.claim: soloLowStakesFacts takes redBefore from the board baseline and machineRun and greenAfter from the check verify ran.

cli.io-commands-verify.solo-check-facts.why: Without it a check run by hand or with no board baseline would read as machine-run red then green.
